Position: Dynamics 365 F&O Finance Lead Consultant

Department: Dynamics 365 F&O UO

Visa Sponsorship: You must have legal working rights in the country of your residence within the European region. Sponsorship is only available within the Netherlands.

**About HSO

**HSO is a global business transformation partner where innovation, AI, and Microsoft technology come together. With 30+ years of Microsoft expertise, 3,000 employees worldwide, 2,000+ clients, and 7,500+ projects delivered, we help organizations unlock the full potential of the Microsoft Cloud.

Recognized as a Microsoft AI Business Solutions Inner Circle Partner for 22 consecutive years and a Microsoft Frontier Partner, HSO is among the top Microsoft partners driving AI-powered transformation worldwide.

**About HSO International

**At HSO International, you'll join a diverse team of 300+ professionals representing more than 50 nationalities. We deliver cross-border transformation programs for international customers, combining local expertise with global reach in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: Life at HSO International

**The Opportunity

**As a D365 Finance Lead Consultant, you work with Microsoft Dynamics 365, the Azure cloud platform, and our unique, industry-specific solutions to develop the best strategy for a digital transformation and design, implement, and manage innovative cloud solutions for our customers. You will lead the Finance workstream of a complex multinational Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations transformation.

**What You’ll Do

****Lead Finance Transformation

**

• Lead the Finance workstream across international Dynamics 365 programs.

• Advise Finance leaders and key stakeholders on processes, operating models, and technology decisions.

• Lead discovery and design workshops, challenge existing processes, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and efficiency.

**Own Finance Solution Design

**

• Own functional design across Dynamics 365 Finance, including General Ledger, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Asset lease, PMA, Revenue recognition, Cost management, Electronic reporting, E-invoicing, Cash & Bank, Budgeting, Credit & Collections, financial reporting and multi-country localizations.

• Ensure Finance solutions work across countries, legal entities, and business units.

• Partner with Solution Architects and other workstreams across integrations, data, testing, and deployment.

**Lead the Workstream

**

• Guide Finance consultants on priorities, dependencies, risks, and key decisions.

• Act as a senior point of contact for the customer Finance team.

• Mentor consultants and maintain quality across Finance deliverables.

**Create Impact Beyond Delivery

**

• Support presales engagements, workshops, and demonstrations.

• Contribute to HSO Finance methodologies, accelerators, and best practices.

• Identify opportunities to apply Copilot, AI, automation, Power Platform, and analytics to Finance transformation.

**What We’re Looking For

**

• At least 10 years of ERP consulting experience with significant Finance expertise.

• Several years of experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and multi-industry project experience.

• Experience leading a Finance workstream or taking senior functional ownership on complex implementations.

• Strong Finance process, workshop facilitation, solution design, and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience with international or enterprise-scale transformations and mentoring consultants.

• Familiarity with Power Platform, Azure, analytics, automation, AI, Copilot, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.

• Strong English communication skills and a collaborative, commercially minded approach.

**What You’ll Gain

**

• Global impact: lead Finance transformation across countries, regions, legal entities, and business units.

• Leadership: take greater ownership while remaining close to Finance, technology, and delivery.

• Freedom: influence solution direction and shape your role around your strengths.

• Innovation: help define how AI, automation, and Copilot change Finance and consulting delivery.

• Growth and flexibility: learn from experienced Dynamics 365 professionals and work from anywhere in Europe.

**Location

**This role can be based anywhere within Europe for candidates with existing European or UK working rights. Travel to customer locations and HSO offices will be required as part of international transformation programs.

About Celvivo

Celvivo is a Danish life science company developing innovative solutions for growing and studying cells in 3D while mimicking in vivo conditions. Our platform brings together advanced laboratory equipment and cloud-based software, helping researchers explore new possibilities in cell culture and achieve new results in their scientific research and their work towards better patient outcomes.

Celvivo has a team of 35 employees across Denmark, the United States, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UAE, and Singapore.

As we expand our presence within the pharmaceutical industry, we are looking for an experienced and entrepreneurial Director of Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs to establish and lead our quality and regulatory journey.

The Opportunity

You will play a central role in preparing Celvivo for increased engagement with pharmaceutical customers, ensuring that our quality systems, certifications, product compliance practices, and regulatory approach support both current and future business objectives.

You will report directly to our CEO and serve as a key member of the management team, defining and implementing Celvivo’s quality and regulatory strategy. Initially, you will be a hands-on leader working closely with external consultants to establish the foundations of the QA/RA function. As the company grows, you will build and develop the QA/RA agenda and capabilities required to support our future ambitions.

This is a unique opportunity to work with a premium product and shape the quality and regulatory strategy at an ambitious growth company, where your decisions will directly influence our future direction, customer relationships, and market opportunities.

What You Will Do

Quality & Regulatory Strategy

• Define Celvivo’s quality and regulatory roadmap, including recommendations regarding certifications, regulatory positioning, and quality investments.

• Advise executive management on strategic quality and regulatory decisions.

• Develop budgets and implementation plans for QA/RA initiatives.

Quality Management System & Certification

• Lead the implementation of a scalable Quality Management System.

• Establish SOP frameworks and key quality processes.

• Drive certification activities and ensure ongoing compliance.

Regulatory Affairs & Product Compliance

• Determine product classifications across key markets, including the EU and US.

• Ensure compliance of product claims, labeling, marketing materials, and CE marking activities.

• Monitor regulatory developments relevant to Celvivo and our customers.

Customer & Supplier Quality

• Serve as the primary quality contact for customers.

• Lead customer and supplier audits.

• Establish and maintain quality agreements with distributors, suppliers, and customers.

• Ensure audit readiness across the organization.

Leadership & Business Partnership

• Collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to create a pragmatic and effective quality culture.

• Maintain external and internal key stakeholders.

• Contribute actively to the management team and overall company strategy.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will:

• 

• Complete a comprehensive gap analysis and recommend Celvivo’s future quality and regulatory path.

• Deliver an approved QA/RA roadmap and budget.

• Establish the SOP framework and document product classifications.

• Implement core QMS processes and prepare the company for certification.

• Develop a scalable resource plan for the future QA/RA organization

What You Bring

We imagine that you bring:

• 

• An MSc or equivalent degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• More than 10 years of QA/RA experience within life science tools, medical devices, diagnostics, or pharmaceutical environments.

• A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders.

• Experience implementing ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485 compliant quality management systems, ideally from the ground up.

• Experience driving certification activities and interacting with auditors.

• Strong knowledge of product classification, labeling, and compliance requirements for laboratory equipment and related technologies.

• Experience working with pharmaceutical customers and quality audits is highly advantageous.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Danish is considered a plus

Why Join Celvivo?

At Celvivo you have the right to be nerdy, the obligation to be friendly, the chance to be pioneering and the privilege of working with premium products. We combine scientific curiosity with entrepreneurial ambition, and we are united by our mission to help researchers achieve better outcomes through smarter ways of working.

As Director of QA/RA, you will have a rare opportunity to create a function from the ground up and make a tangible impact on Celvivo’s future growth and success together with a team of passionate colleagues.

Interested? Send us your CV and a cover letter with a few words about yourself, your experience, and what motivates you to join Celvivo.

Would you like to be part of a finance department where you contribute both to the daily operations and to shaping and developing processes and workflows? Do you thrive in a role where you collaborate with colleagues and managers across the company? Then you might be our new controller.

Controller for a Growing Company in the Metal Industry

At Danpres A/S, we are a team of about 100 skilled and dedicated employees who develop and manufacture customized metal components for, among others, the renewable energy and food industries in Denmark and Germany.

We have many exciting projects in the pipeline and are continuing to grow. That’s why we are now looking for a new colleague to join our finance team, which currently consists of three employees.

Daily Operations and Development

As a controller in our finance team, your workday will be varied – including recurring key figures you track and follow up on to ensure correct registration. You support the accounting function and communicate with the sales and production leadership on how we can improve processes and work smarter.

Most importantly, our daily operations must run smoothly. We all need to be able to step in for each other and get the job done. That’s why we need you to bring structure and help create a collaborative environment where we understand each other’s tasks and coordinate continuously to stay aligned.

You will also play a key role in supporting the entire company with sparring, support, and suggestions for improvements to help us continuously evolve and work more efficiently. This requires a flexible mindset, patience, and the ability to adapt your communication to the many different colleagues and leaders you will work with.

What We Offer:

• A versatile role in a finance team covering accounting and controlling – including hands-on bookkeeping, reporting and support, budgeting, annual reports, KPI views, etc.

• A high degree of freedom and influence to shape your role, the direction, and how we do things.

• A broad collaboration with colleagues across the office and production floor.

• Close cooperation with your immediate manager to set clear goals that support your development.

• A company culture where we work daily on building job satisfaction and team spirit.

• An active staff association, lunch arrangement, and shared breakfast every Friday.

What We Expect from You:

• You have a relevant education and a solid professional skill set.

• You have strong analytical skills and are proficient in Excel.

• You take initiative and responsibility for moving tasks forward.

• You are patient and communicate constructively with colleagues.

• You are interested in or open to automation and can help identify smarter ways of working.

• You are comfortable communicating in both English and German.

• Experience from a manufacturing company and familiarity with Monitor ERP is a plus.

Further Information

Feel free to contact Finance Manager Lars Noe at +45 86 95 23 00 if you have any questions. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Start date: as soon as possible.

Send your CV and application to hr@danpres.dk – write “Controller” in the subject line. Let us know why you’d like to work with us and what you can contribute.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Danpres A/S

We provide customized component solutions for a wide range of industries and currently employ around 100 people at our site in Låsby, Denmark. Our customers are large manufacturing companies in Denmark and Germany, and we handle projects from initial idea to final assembly. Our modern 10,000 m² production facility houses 18 robots, and we continuously invest in new technology. At Danpres, our employees are our most valuable asset, and we actively invest in culture, collaboration, and workplace satisfaction.

Customised customer solutions require a supplier base that can support complexity, speed and technical value creation. As Sourcing Manager – Design-to-Order (DTO), you will strengthen NOVENCO’s competitive position by building supplier partnerships that support engineered solutions, modular thinking, cost optimisation and supply chain resilience.

**Your Impact

**

• Identify, evaluate and develop suppliers for customised components, balancing quality, cost, delivery performance, sustainability and supply chain risk.

• Bring the right suppliers into early design phases to support Design for Manufacturing principles and optimise total cost of ownership.

• Negotiate framework agreements, contracts and pricing structures that support volatile demand, complex components and project-specific requirements.

• Build long-term supplier partnerships capable of handling special materials, technical complexity, variable order volumes and long lead times.

• Monitor supplier performance through KPIs, with particular focus on delivery reliability, quality, cost efficiency and compliance with standards.

• Identify commonalities across customised products to increase component reuse, reduce complexity and support a more scalable supply base.

**What Drives Success

**

• Solid experience with Design-to-Order sourcing, international procurement and global supply chain management.

• Strong understanding of modular architecture, supplier segmentation, risk management, compliance and relevant quality and sustainability standards.

• Commercial strength combined with technical understanding from a project-oriented or engineered-to-order environment.

• Ability to challenge design concepts early to prevent unnecessary cost, complexity and material risk.

• Strong negotiation skills and professional English communication, both written and spoken.

**What We Offer

**

• A central role in Global Sourcing with direct impact on NOVENCO’s supplier strategy and competitiveness.

• The opportunity to shape strategic supplier partnerships for complex, customised and technically demanding solutions.

• Close collaboration with R&D, Project, Quality, Product Development and Supply Chain stakeholders.

• Exposure to international suppliers, markets and material networks, including expected travel of 30–40 days per year.

• Competitive salary and employee benefits in line with company policy.

• 25 days’ annual leave plus 5 days Feriefri after the qualifying period.

• Standard auto-enrolment pension scheme and access to a healthcare scheme.

• Professional development and training through NOVENCollege, with clear progression paths.

**Context

**The role is part of Global Sourcing and reports to the Head of Global Sourcing. You will work at the intersection of customised customer solutions, DTO, R&D, Projects and Supply Chain, with supplier visits in Denmark and internationally.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your CV via our careers page. Applications are reviewed on receipt and interviews are scheduled on a rolling basis.

NOVENCO Building & Industry is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

Corti builds AI for critical industries. We started in healthcare, where messy inputs, specialized knowledge, and consequential errors make demanding engineering problems unavoidable. Today we train and post-train models, build agents, and turn research into APIs that developers use to build their products. Our platform supports more than one million production interactions every week.

We are building Europe’s alternative to closed AI: ambitious model development, published research, and AI infrastructure that gives developers control over the systems they depend on.

Our platform and APIs provide the building blocks for specialized intelligence that organizations own:

• 
Models: frontier and open-weight models with reasoning, tool calling, structured output, and embeddings through an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus custom models trained and post-trained on an organization’s own data.

• 
Sovereign compute: GPU capacity on Corti-operated European infrastructure for teams that need their data and workloads to stay in Europe.

• 
Agents: a harness to build, evaluate, and optimize agents that connect to real systems, with planning, tool use, external knowledge, persistent context, human approval, and observable execution.

• 
Speech: live dictation, conversational transcription, and batch audio processing.

• 
Clinical documentation: fact extraction as conversations unfold, and document generation with explicit schemas and controllable synthesis.

• 
Medical coding: code predictions from clinical narratives, linked to supporting passages.

Explore the platform at docs.corti.ai.

The Role

You want to train models at the frontier, and you want the science in the open, where other engineers can inspect it. At Corti, you don't have to choose.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in our Applied AI team, you drive large-scale training and post-training alongside researchers and engineers. Your decisions span the training recipe, the evaluation, and the system that serves the result. The calls are consequential, and you stay close enough to the implementation to understand why they succeed or fail.

What You Will Do

• 
Designing and running distributed training, including architecture, data pipelines, parallelism, checkpointing, evaluation, and recovery.

• 
Improving model capabilities through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation.

• 
Finding the causes of unstable training, inefficient communication, poor utilization, and unexpected regressions.

• 
Developing models for agentic work: choosing tools, using evidence, maintaining context, and completing complex tasks reliably.

• 
Building evaluations that expose failure modes and establish whether an improvement holds outside the training distribution, including LLM-as-judge systems you build and calibrate

• 
Creating and curating training data, including synthetic data pipelines that feed real training runs.

• 
Turning stronger models into practical APIs by improving latency, throughput, memory use, and serving cost.

Which capabilities belong in the weights, and which need tools or retrieval? You help decide, and you build the experiments that establish the answer.

Put the science where engineers can inspect it

We believe engineers should be able to examine the methods and evidence behind the systems they build on. We publish research, release benchmark resources, and document how our platform works. Read the work behind our clinical APIs: corti.ai/research

Who you are

You have depth and an urge to experiment

• 
You have trained large language models and owned technically complex ML work. You can explain a difficult run in detail: the architecture, the bottleneck, the failed hypothesis, and the evidence that changed your mind.

• 
You bring strong practical distributed-training experience, and depth in areas such as mixture-of-experts models, reinforcement learning, or distillation. Experience serving open-weight models is a plus. You write code other engineers can build on and make technical trade offs clear.

• 
You know post-training methods from the inside.Preference optimisation and reinforcement learning have quirks, reward hacking, runs that look stable until they collapse, and signals that turns out to be noise. You have hit these problems and learned to spot them before they cost you a week.

• 
You have hands-on experience with the data the models learn from. You have built training-data pipelines, ideally synthetic ones, and stayed close to the training that consumed your data.

• 
You have evaluated LLMs in production. You have built and calibrated LLM-as-judge systems to automate that evaluation, and you know when a judge's score means something and when it just flatters the model it is scoring.

• 
You also have the itch to investigate. A new model, paper, or agent framework appears, and you want to understand what actually changed. You build experiments, compare approaches, and test the claims. Perhaps your latest side project involves agents building tools, coordinating with other agents, or failing in a surprisingly instructive way. We want to hear about it.

• 
A relevant advanced degree is welcome; equivalent experience matters just as much.

Build with us in Copenhagen

This is a full-time role reporting to the CTO. We provide equipment and relocation support.

We welcome different backgrounds and paths into machine learning. If the work fits your ambition and you bring substantial relevant experience, apply even if you do not match every item.

Send us something you built, a hard problem you solved, or a result you think deserves to be challenged. A link is enough. Help us shape the models, agents, and infrastructure developers build on next.

We treat all candidates equally, are committed to bringing in top talent from all sectors and countries, and will not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Additionally, we want to remind you that experience comes in many forms, and we're passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we're looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you consider applying!

**Why we are hiring

**Spirii is growing. We work with charge point operators, businesses and fleets in several European markets, we take part in more and more tenders, and our commercial team has grown along the way. With growth comes friction. Deals and tenders are tracked in different places, the numbers in the CRM do not always match what we bill, and it takes too much effort to answer simple questions like “what will we close this quarter?”

We want one person to own the engine behind our revenue: the CRM, the data, and the path a customer takes from first contact to signed deal, onboarding and correct billing. That is this role. You will make work easier for our sales, marketing, onboarding and customer success teams, and you will give leadership numbers they can trust.

**The team

**You will report to our CSO. You will own Revenue Operations from end to end, and you will work every day with sales development, account executives, marketing, onboarding and customer success, and closely with Finance on billing data.

**What You Will Do

****CRM and tools

**

• Own and improve HubSpot, our CRM, so everyone works from the same clean data

• Make sure every deal and tender is tracked in one place, from first contact to result

• Set up and improve lead routing

• Bring in the other tools the commercial team needs, such as order management, bid management and lead development

• Make sure master data is correct, so billing runs smoothly

**Metrics and forecasting

**

• Define and track our core SaaS metrics: ARR, ACV, TCV, NRR and pipeline stages

• Run the weekly forecast and track how accurate it is

• Connect marketing, sales development, account executives and customer success, so the forecast reflects what is really happening

**Data and reporting

**

• Build dashboards that leadership trusts and uses to make decisions

• Keep the CRM clean and reconcile it with billing data

**Planning and sales process

**

• Build one clear sales process, with the same stages and rules from lead to handover across teams and markets

• Support territory design and regional planning reviews

• Run capacity modelling and lead quota planning

• Improve the path from lead to opportunity

**What Success Looks Like After Your First Year

**

• Leadership opens one dashboard and trusts what it sees

• Every deal and tender lives in HubSpot, and CRM data matches billing data

• The weekly forecast is a habit, and it gets more accurate over time

• Every market follows the same sales process

• Our sales team spends less time on admin and more time with customers

**What You Bring

**

• 5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or commercial analytics in a B2B SaaS company

• Strong CRM administration skills, ideally in HubSpot

• A track record of building tools and processes that help a sales organisation work better

• Comfort with data: Excel, SQL, or BI tools such as Tableau

• A good understanding of SaaS business models and unit economics

• Hands-on experience bringing AI tools into a sales or marketing team

• Fluent English. Another European language, such as German, French, Dutch, Swedish, Danish or Italian, is a big plus

• A degree in business, engineering or a similar field, or equivalent experience

**Who You Are

**

• You enjoy building things from the ground up, and you are comfortable when not everything is defined yet

• You take ownership and follow through

• You can think big picture and still roll up your sleeves to fix a workflow yourself

• You explain data clearly, whether you are talking to a sales rep or to the leadership team

• You like working with people from many countries and cultures

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

**About Spirii – Who We Are

**Spirii is a full-service e-mobility provider which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii was founded seven years ago as a company. Nevertheless, the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport- and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

OJ drives, controllers and thermostats are subject to tough performance demands and stringent regulatory requirements. Making sure they excel consistently takes thorough testing, expert validation, and solid documentation. If you have experience with PRODUCT COMPLIANCE, EMC AND LVD, CERTIFICATION AND APPROVALS, and SYSTEMATIC TESTING, consider joining our team as a QA and Product Compliance Engineer.

OJ Electronics is looking for a QA and Product Compliance Engineer to help make sure our products live up to our customers’ expectations – also in terms of compliance with all applicable regulations.

As QA and Product Compliance Engineer, you’ll be involved in the demanding process of taking our products from technical development to verified, documented compliance. This includes planning and carrying out tests, supporting certification and approval processes, and making sure all required technical evidence is in place.

Joining our QA & Product Compliance department here in Sønderborg, you’ll work closely with engineers, other technical specialists, our in-house test center, and external testing laboratories. You’ll enjoy a varied workday, combining hands-on technical responsibilities with planning, documentation and coordination – giving you direct influence on the quality of our full range of products.

Your role

Reporting to the line manager in QA & Product Compliance, your responsibilities will include:

• Planning, coordinating and executing product validation work

• Preparing test plans and ensuring that testing is completed and documented

• Carrying out conformance and acceptance testing

• Working with relevant standards and requirements, including EMC and LVD

• Supporting product certification and approval processes

• Coordinating testing and documentation with external test houses

• Preparing and maintaining technical compliance documentation

• Participating in internal audits and facilitating D-FMEA activities

• Providing technical support to colleagues across the organization

• Contributing to the work of our in-house test center

• Supporting the preparation and signing of CE and UKCA declarations

Must-have qualifications

• A technical education, such as an engineering degree or electronics technician qualification

• Experience with product testing and validation, including systematic test procedures and test planning

• Experience with product compliance and CE marking, including requirements under the Low Voltage, EMC and Radio Equipment Directives

• The ability to interpret EN, IEC, and similar standards and translate them into concrete development requirements

• Experience facilitating D-FMEA activities

• Experience with certification and product approval processes, including the preparation and maintenance of technical documentation and declarations of conformity

• Previous work experience in electronics, product testing, compliance or a similarly regulated technical environment

• A systematic, analytical approach to your work and the ability to collaborate with different technical specialists

• Good comprehension of both English and German

Nice-to-have qualifications

• Experience with internal audits and compliance reviews, ideally in an organization with an ISO 9001-based quality management system

• Knowledge of PPAP and how compliance documentation, such as material data, RoHS/REACH declarations and test reports, supports the approval of parts for series production

• Experience coordinating testing with external laboratories and certification bodies

• Experience with certifications such as UL/cUL or with market access outside the EU

• Practical involvement in test-center activities

• Experience providing technical support in cross-functional development projects

Working at OJ

At OJ Electronics, you’ll find an informal, open and collaborative culture where people take pride in doing quality work.

We offer:

• A flat organizational structure where decisions are made quickly

• Opportunities to grow your expertise and responsibility over time

• A healthy work-life balance and flexible working hours

• Competitive salary and pension package

• A modern workplace with canteen and good facilities

Employee satisfaction scores average 85 – and we take pride in maintaining a workplace where people truly thrive.

Please note that this position is based in Sønderborg, Denmark, and requires your physical presence on site. The position involves 5–10 travel days per year, depending on business needs and mutual agreement.

The application process

For this position, we will be interviewing on an ongoing basis until we find the right person.

About OJ Electronics

Founded in 1964 and headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark, OJ Electronics produces electronic controls for underfloor heating and HVAC controls and drives. Our products are available through partners and distributors worldwide, and we have subsidiaries and sales offices in key markets, including the United States and Poland. Everywhere, we are known for our innovative approach, insistence on product quality, and deep application knowledge – all of which helps customers differentiate themselves in the market.

In June 2023, OJ Electronics was acquired by BITZER Electronics, a BITZER Group company also headquartered in Sønderborg. This makes OJ Electronics part of the BITZER Group family, which is represented at 75 locations in over 40 countries and employs some 4300 people worldwide, 200 in OJ Electronics, Sønderborg, Denmark.

**Do you want to use your understanding of electronic systems design to create innovative products that make a difference to people with hearing disabilities?

**At GN Hearing, your work will support hearing solutions that help people engage more easily in the conversations and surroundings important to them.

As an Electronic Design Engineer, you will work across the development journey: shaping system specifications, exploring new technology, building and verifying prototypes, and preparing solutions for production. You will bring your experience and curiosity to a team that works closely across disciplines to solve complex technical challenges.

Your contribution will ensure our technology forms a perfect synthesis and creates a good sound when packed into our tiny hearing aids. This process takes you through system design development, prototyping and advanced platform integration technologies.

Whether you bring established PCB design experience or are ready to build further on a solid foundation, you will have knowledgeable colleagues around you and opportunities to contribute your perspective.

**Welcome to GN Hearing

**You will join the Electronic Integration team, part of Product Development in R&D. Our team consists of specialist engineers who collaborate across hardware, platform and product development. We value open technical discussions, practical problem-solving and sharing what we know. You will join colleagues who take their work seriously while maintaining an informal and supportive way of working.

Together with other teams, we define, design, implement and verify the ReSound programmable DSP platform, including 2.4 GHz Bluetooth Low Energy and Auracast™ wireless communication capabilities.

**Your contribution is appreciated, and you will:

**

• Contribute to electronic design development of hearing aids and accessories, from prototype stage and design verification through to production, influencing architecture and design decisions

• Evaluate and implement new technologies in hearing-aid electronics

• Design and coordinate test verification activities to ensure reliable product performance

• Create and maintain documentation required for regulatory compliance

• Collaborate with cross-functional colleagues to integrate platform technologies into compact hearing solutions

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

**

• Hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in electronic engineering, with a focus on signal integration or a related field

• Bring relevant experience in analog and baseband digital design

• Understand electronic systems design

• Can work through and enjoy complex technical questions and analytical problem solving

• May have experience with Cadence Allegro schematic tools

• Work well with others across technical disciplines

• Communicate proficiently in English

We pride ourselves on encouraging flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it is needed most.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than November 27, 2026. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and we may close the position before the application deadline if we find the right candidate. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement **here.

**

**About You

**

• You are genuinely passionate about our purpose.

DKK607.920,00---911.880,00

As the technical authority for electrical systems and critical power infrastructure, you will provide expert guidance across both project delivery and operations, ensuring technical excellence, engineering integrity, and operational reliability throughout the asset lifecycle.

**

• Drive training, technical mentoring, and knowledge sharing across operational and engineering teams to strengthen capability and consistency.

**Your profile:

**

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Fluent English and willingness to travel across the Nordic region as required.

**About the atNorth Culture

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together. #99

**Security and Fire Specialist, Denmark

****Lyngby, Odense, Vejle, Esbjerg, Aarhus, Aalborg

**Full-time Permanent

Hybrid

Are you a fire protection and security systems specialist looking to develop robust technical solutions within one of Denmark’s largest electrical engineering teams in Buildings and Industry? Do you thrive on thoughtful building design, reliable systems and multidisciplinary collaboration across a diverse project portfolio? If so, we would like to hear from you.

**Create the solutions that enable a better tomorrow

**We are seeking a Senior Security and Fire Specialist to strengthen our expertise in security and fire protection systems for complex projects that support essential societal functions. You will join COWI’s Buildings and Industry division, where approximately 500 specialists work with clients on some of the most significant projects in Denmark and internationally.

You will be part of an international network of specialists, collaborating closely with colleagues across disciplines and countries. With a primary focus on fire protection and security systems, you will play a key technical role in both your own assignments and larger multidisciplinary projects. Sustainability and digital development are priorities at COWI, and an interest in integrating these perspectives into your work would be an advantage.

We welcome candidates from a range of professional backgrounds. As a large electrical engineering discipline within Buildings and Industry, we bring together diverse skills and experience, united by a commitment to collaboration, integrity and a positive working environment. You may have a qualification in electrical installation, electrical engineering, marine and technical engineering, or a related field.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Working with fire protection and security systems, including ABA, ABDL, AVA, ABV, ADK, AIA and TVO

• Preparing project documentation throughout all phases of major construction projects

• Providing technical consultancy, design, specifications and tender documentation for security and fire protection systems

• Undertaking project follow-up, site supervision and commissioning of security and fire protection systems

• Developing and sharing best practice, exchanging knowledge and maintaining up-to-date technical expertise within the discipline

**Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You will also bring

• In-depth knowledge of security and fire protection systems, gained through practical experience, formal education or a combination of both; your specific educational background is not a determining factor

• The ability to communicate clearly, precisely and unambiguously in both written and spoken English and Danish

• Recent, relevant experience with security and fire protection systems

• Ideally, more than 10 years of experience providing consultancy on security and fire protection systems

• Knowledge of CER and NIS2 would be an advantage

• The ability to obtain security clearance to at least HEM (SECRET) level

**A place to work – and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Do you have more questions?

**For more information about the position and what we offer, please contact Priyanka, our Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, at prki@cowi.com.

Learn more about our projects, strategy, ambitions and life at COWI at www.cowi.com.

We are committed to a fair and unbiased recruitment process. To support this, please do not include a photograph in your CV.

**About Flatpay

**Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

**About The Job

**Flatpay has become one of Europe's fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept card payments in-store.

Our Point of Sale system serves as the central engine of the business. It streamlines the merchant's entire workflow — from order taking, product and inventory management, to payment processing, reporting, and compliance.

**Some Of The Core Capabilities Include

**

• Product catalogue: Organizes how they manage their products, categories, modifiers and inventory

• Order management: Basket, pricing, discounts, payments and managing tables and long-running orders among groups of customers.

• Hardware integrations to barcode scanners, receipt and kitchen/bar printers and our different Mobile-, Premium- and Basic POS devices. No least manage synchronicity across multiple POS systems at shared locations in realtime.

• Our reporting suite ensures cash management, end-of-day reports, various sales, turnover, staff, tax and compliance reports that enables merchants to optimize their business and comply with local tax regulations.

As our merchants grow, so does the platform. Every new market introduces new payment methods, fiscal requirements and merchant needs. Every new feature increases the depth and complexity of the product. And with our customer base doubling approximately every six months, the demands on scalability, reliability and performance continue to grow.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant ownership. You'll influence technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions and solve the engineering challenges that come with building one of Europe's fastest-growing commerce platforms.

What you'll do

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll contribute far beyond implementation. You'll help shape technical direction while remaining deeply involved in building products. You'll work closely with Product, Design and fellow engineers to build software that scales across all dimensions: more merchants, more markets, more capabilities and increasingly sophisticated workflows.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Designing, building and evolving features across our Point of Sale platform platform.

• Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production

• Build APIs, services, and integrations that enable stock, order lifecycle, sales reporting & compliance reporting towards governmental standards of our markets.

• Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance

• Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements

• Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform

• Mentor engineers through coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

• Continuously improving our engineering practices, tooling and development experience

• Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

Who you are

We're looking for experienced engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems and helping others succeed.

**You Likely Bring

**

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience

• Strong experience designing and operating distributed systems

• Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects involving multiple engineers and influence architectural decisions

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and helping shape new products and systems

• The ability to break down complex problems into pragmatic, maintainable solutions.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Experience building scalable backend platforms and APIs

• Continuously improve CI/CD pipelines

• A collaborative mindset and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively

• Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

• Experience within payments, fintech, e-commerce, SaaS, or high-scale transaction systems is a plus

You'll be working with the following technologies; we don't expect experience with every technology listed; we're looking for engineers who can learn quickly and help us build great products.

• Java, Spring Boot, JUnit

• MySQL, Flyway, SQS

• REST APIs

• Domain Driven Design

• Docker, Terraform, AWS ECS

• Ports and adapters architecture

**Why Flatpay

**Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?
